summary.en: The whole flow as an exploded view: 2–5 nodes float apart on dash-dot centre lines between two amber ends, then snap into one chain on a beat; amber brackets over the ends, a loop label, a claim and its sub.
summary.zh: 把整个流程画成爆炸图：2–5 个节点沿点划线中心线悬开，夹在两个琥珀色端点之间，然后在一拍上咬合成一条链；两端加琥珀色括号，再加回环标签、一句主张和副句。

fits: The flow with people at both ends: who starts it, what runs, who signs.
notFor: Flows with branches; more than five nodes; flows with no person (the ends are people).

intent.en: Assemble the system in front of the viewer: separate parts click into one chain, and the people at its ends are amber.
intent.zh: 在观众眼前把系统装起来：分散的部件咔哒合成一条链，两端的人是琥珀色。

content.en: Title (≤ 26), two ends (word ≤ 5, sub ≤ 16), an end tag, 2–5 nodes (≤ 12), a loop label, a claim (≤ 36), a sub.
content.zh: 标题（≤ 10 字）、两端（词 ≤ 2 字、副注 ≤ 6 字）、端点标签、2–5 个节点（≤ 4 字）、回环标签、主张（≤ 14 字）、副句。

fits.zh: 两端是人的流程：谁发起、跑什么、谁签字。

notFor.zh: 有分支的流程；超过五个节点；没有人的流程（两端代表人）。

en: A six-word claim reads past the build at 100 BPM; keep it to five words.
zh: 100 BPM 下六个词的主张读不完；控制在五个词以内（中文 ≤ 14 字）。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
